patch_description: This design replaces the archive-driven neighborhood search with a recombination-and-walk strategy. It first LP-scores a small, diverse set of repaired QAOA samples, then alternates between degree-preserving walks and short paths toward other promising networks. Path steps increase overlap with a chosen target, providing a directed way to combine useful link patterns from different samples. LP calls are spent on a small screened set of proposals, while a temperature-based acceptance rule lets the walk cross local score barriers. Bottleneck information biases some exchanges, but unrestricted proposals remain available to avoid overfitting to a single LP dual solution.
